mapper.select: SELECT qty - #{qty} as qty FROM PRODUCTS WHERE productid = #{productid}

SELECT c.productid ,p.categoryid ,p.pnm ,p.title ,DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(p.cont, 200, 1) as cont ,p.qty as pqty ,c.qty ,p.price ,p.price * c.qty subtot ,u.usrnm FROM P_CART c JOIN products p ON c.productid = p.productid JOIN USERS u ON u.usrno = c.usrno WHERE u.usrno = #{usrno}
